WebChain v2
	

A large-scale, human-annotated dataset of real-world web interaction trajectories for training and evaluating web agents.
[Paper] [Code] [Dataset]
WebChain captures how people complete real tasks on live websites. It is designed for agents that must both identify the correct interface element and reason through a sequence of actions.
